evidence.quote: i candidati stranieri e/o richiedenti visto e residenti all'estero devono compilare e presentare la domanda di preiscrizione ai corsi di studio universitari esclusivamente in modalità telematica, accedendo al portale UNIVERSITALY (https://www.universitaly.it)

notes: Tuition left out: no page states a single EUR amount for a full-time Bachelor student from outside the EU living abroad for the current academic year; the pages only mention generic fee reductions for international students. Application deadline: the page gives 21 September 2026 for non-EU residents, but this deadline comes from the programme page and is labeled 'for non EU residents'. The application channel quote comes from the Economics department page about foreign-student pre-enrolment at the same university (UNIVERSITALY); the Data Analytics pages themselves do not name the application portal.

note.fr: Les candidats non-UE résidant à l'étranger doivent passer le test CISIA CEnT-S (en anglais) uniquement pour les sections Mathematics et Reasoning ; le résultat détermine le classement.
note.en: Non-EU applicants residing abroad must take the CISIA CEnT-S test (in English) only for the Mathematics and Reasoning sections; the score determines the ranking.

evidence.quote: Take the CISIA CEnT-S test (English test for Science subjects)
Only the Mathematics and Reasoning sections (30 questions total) count toward your ranking

note.fr: Le seuil minimum est de 11 points au total dans les sections Mathematics et Reasoning, avec au moins 6 points en Mathematics ; les places pour les non-résidents dans l'UE sont de 100 (appel d'été).
note.en: The minimum threshold is a combined score of at least 11 points in the Mathematics and Reasoning sections, with at least 6 points in Mathematics; there are 100 places for students residing in non-EU countries (summer call).

evidence.quote: Applicants must achieve a combined score of at least 11 points, with a sub-minimum of at least 6 points specifically in the Mathematics section.
